assets.label: Identité · deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL fan-game vehicle asset for La Longue Chasse. This is a new game design proposal, not a film vehicle replica. Exactly TWO complete side-profile views arranged SIDE BY SIDE in TWO COLUMNS and ONE ROW: left vehicle faces RIGHT, right vehicle faces LEFT, independently drawn opposite sides with coherent matching construction. Horizontal orthographic side-scrolling camera, not isometric or top view. All vehicle parts fully visible, identical scale, each fits central70percent of its cell with broad empty margins and center gutter. Flat pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background with no shadows, glow spill, checkerboard, text, labels, symbols, grid or environment. No pilot, passengers, bodies, trophies, crates, detachable weapons, exhaust plumes or dust; these belong to independent modules. Sharp detailed painted sci-fi game art, believable serviceable construction, dark weathered metal and restrained bronze accents, no copied logos. Vehicle: SKIMMER DES DUNES, an original broad low desert antigravity craft. Long sandstone-bronze armored body, low protected central rider well without canopy, compact control yoke integrated in the well, broad side outrigger pods attached through sturdy low braces and layered downward-facing antigravity emitter housings. Near and far outriggers readable as connected structure in side profile, not loose floating parts. Sand-worn plating, screened cooling vents, rugged replaceable front skid bumper that normally floats above the sand, subdued teal power accents. A wide stable desert silhouette, heavier than a scout board, no wheels, tracks, sails, large wings or guns. Do not draw dust or ground; dust plumes must remain separate assets.

references.role: Partial original game design brief; styling details remain proposals.
